name: Libserial
reason: README and WebSearch show no performance claim or numbers; it is an object-oriented wrapper over POSIX serial I/O with no named baseline compared (WebSearch for benchmarks against termios or Boost.Asio serial found none).

name: libtrading
listed_description: Implementation of network protocols for communicating with exchanges, dark pools and other trading venues. Supports FIX, FIX/FAST and many proprietary protocols.
reason: README gives own latency numbers (FIX round trip 6 us, FAST 13 us, fix_client avg 16.8 us on a Haswell 3.60 GHz) but compares against no other FIX engine; wiki home has no benchmark; libtrading.org is egress-blocked and WebSearch found no QuickFIX comparison. Absolute numbers without a named baseline do not qualify.

name: libutp
reason: README has no numbers; uTP is a delay-minimizing LEDBAT transport, not claimed faster than TCP; WebSearch found no libutp benchmark against TCP (the one blog test surfaced covers a different uTP implementation and was egress-blocked).

name: LibVNCServer
listed_description: Cross-platform libraries to implement VNC server and/or client.
reason: README only has a 'good performance on slow links' tuning section with no numbers; WebSearch found no benchmark against TigerVNC or other VNC servers. Not an HTTP server either, so the guessed category does not apply.

name: libwebsock
listed_description: Easy-to-use and powerful web socket library.
reason: Repo page and raw README return 404 (also payden/libwebsock); no benchmark found in WebSearch (two queries), so no numbers against any baseline could be reached.
